items.note: **keep** = manter. ele/ela: **keeps** · passado: **kept** · perfeito: **has kept** · gerúndio: **is keeping** · condicional: **would have kept**

items.note: **examine** = examinar. ele/ela: **examines** · passado: **examined** · perfeito: **has examined** · gerúndio: **is examining** · condicional: **would have examined**

f: She **would have won** over the sceptics.

items.note: **win** = conquistar. ele/ela: **wins** · passado: **won** · perfeito: **has won** · gerúndio: **is winning** · condicional: **would have won**

items.note: **fly off** = sair voando. ele/ela: **flies** · passado: **flew** · perfeito: **has flown** · gerúndio: **is flying** · condicional: **would have flown**
